crossRefs.note: The river will swarm with frogs, which will go up and come into your house, and into your bedroom, and on your bed, and…
Moses said to Pharaoh, “I give you the honor of setting the time that I should pray for you, and for your servants, and…

people.name: Nile
people.line: The major river of Egypt, mentioned in various contexts

translations.web: The frogs shall depart from you, and from your houses, and from your servants, and from your people. They shall remain in the river only.”
translations.bsb: The frogs will depart from you and your houses and your officials and your people; they will remain only in the Nile.”
translations.kjv: And the frogs shall depart from thee, and from thy houses, and from thy servants, and from thy people; they shall remain in the river
translations.asv: And the frogs shall depart from thee, and from thy houses, and from thy servants, and from thy people; they shall remain in the river only.
